DISCIPLINE 01 • VITAL CIRCUITS

Railway Signalling & Circuit Engineering

RDSO & IRS COMPLIANT

Our proficient engineering team specializes in crafting fail-safe circuits that serve as the bedrock of modern Indian Railways infrastructure across all major electronic interlocking systems:

Electronic Interlocking (EI) Application Logic

Scheme plans, Selection tables (Table of Control), VDU Control layouts, Application Logic, and Interface Circuits for Medha, Kyosan, Siemens, and Ansaldo/Hitachi.

ATP & Kavach / TCAS Modernization

Kavach / TCAS trackside integration, ETCS Level 1 & 2 circuit design, PTC interfaces, and Communication-Based Train Control (CBTC) compatibility.

Independent Proof Consultancy (IV&V)

DISCIPLINE 03 • SYSTEM ASSURANCE

System Assurance & RAMS Management

CENELEC EN 50126/128/129

RAMS (Reliability, Availability, Maintainability, Safety) management stands at the core of our assurance engineering, ensuring fail-safe rail operations to international benchmarks:

CENELEC European Rail Standards Compliance

EN 50126 (RAMS Lifecycle Process), EN 50128 (Software for Railway Control & Protection), and EN 50129 (Safety-Related Electronic Signalling Systems).

Hazard Analysis & Safety Cases

Preliminary Hazard Analysis (PHA), FMECA, Fault Tree Analysis (FTA), Hazard Logs, and preparation of rigorous SIL-4 Safety Cases for independent safety auditors.

Proven Global MNC Engagements

Platform Screen Door (PSD) SIL 2 Safety Documentation for BEL, Eastern Dedicated Freight Corridor (EDFC) verification for Siemens, and multi-OEM projects.

DISCIPLINE 04 • SOFTWARE TOOLS

Rail Software & Signalling Automation

IN-HOUSE DIGITAL TOOLS

We develop proprietary software applications that eliminate tedious manual drafting errors, accelerate Table of Control verifications, and stress-test dense railway corridors:

SENTRIS (Automated Factory Testing Engine)

Automated Factory Acceptance Testing (A-FAT) application ensuring zero-error validation of Electronic Interlocking data tables in under 4 hours.

SENS Interactive Traffic Simulator

Micro-simulation tool allowing interlocking designers and railway dispatchers to stress-test timetable headways, route locks, and incident responses.

AutoCAD Logic Compiler (Algen & L2L)

Transforms station yard schematics into certified Boolean logic equations automatically, cutting manual drafting cycle times by up to 60%.

EXECUTION RIGOR

Our 5-Phase Signalling Lifecycle

A structured, auditable quality framework designed for first-pass CRS approval and zero-defect reliability.

01

Feasibility & Field Survey

On-site gradient, curvature, point machine clearance, and signal sighting committee reviews.

02

SIP Drafting & TOC

Signal Interlocking Plans, route tables, dog charts, and overlap isolation calculations.

03

Application Logic & Circuits

Boolean interlocking equations, wiring schedules, contact analyses, and rack layouts.

04

Automated FAT Testing

Virtual yard testing via SENTRIS tool with automated test vector injection and zero-error signoff.

05

Site SAT & CRS Sanction

On-site bell testing, square sheets validation, safety dossiers, and commercial commissioning.
